name: onplana
description: Onplana plugins for Claude Code. Project planning and autonomous execution against the Onplana MCP server.

plugins.name: onplana
plugins.description: Plan and run projects in Onplana from Claude Code. Describe the work and get a real plan back: epics, tasks, estimates, dependencies and scheduled dates. Ships the Onplana project-planning and autonomous-agent skills, and connects to the Onplana MCP server, with /onplana-connect to sign in.

plugins.name: onplana-waiting
plugins.description: A Waiting on you pane beside the chat in Claude Code: your Onplana tasks handed back to you and your tasks due today or overdue, each linked, plus a text box where one line becomes a task and a text with a task link becomes a comment. Open it with /onplana-waiting. Uses the Onplana MCP server, the same one the onplana plugin connects.
